(level 4): Objective-C classes with superclass, iOS introduction version and
member names; protocols; enumerations with raw values; exported constants and

`+` is a class member, `(ro)` read-only; a version in brackets is the member's
own introduction version when it differs from its type; `(deprecated)` and
`(unavailable)` refer to iOS. No declarations, types or documentation are
reproduced. Behavior is specified in `interface.md`.
